name: ChatGPT / Codex
notes: Shares ~/.codex configuration with the Codex CLI; restart to pick up config changes. On Windows both the ChatGPT app and the standalone Codex desktop app install from the Microsoft Store under their package-family directories. On macOS the unified app is ChatGPT.app (bundle id com.openai.codex since the July 2026 merger); Codex.app is the pre-merger standalone that can linger.
